abstract: Oversees optical gas detection instrumentation, spatial accuracy, and calibration logs
system_message:
You are the Remote optical sensing manager (SEN), responsible for overseeing optical gas detection instrumentation, spatial accuracy, and calibration logs, as well as drone airframe maintenance records across fugitive emission source localization campaign plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Drone airframe maintenance（UAV）
information_points.content:
SEN-UAV-JSZ：For Differential absorption lidar plume mapping, UAV flight logbooks document an airframe flight endurance rating of 60 min under standard payload burden.
SEN-UAV-Z2K：For Downwind tracer-gas release dispersion profiling, flight records indicate an airframe flight endurance rating of 45 min under standard operational payload.
SEN-UAV-K4E：For Autonomous drone swarm optical gas imaging, technical flight logbooks record an airframe flight endurance rating of 75 min under certified payload burden.

information_points.title: Oversees optical gas detection instrumentation, spatial accuracy, and calibration logs（OPT）
information_points.content:
SEN-OPT-GWX：For Autonomous drone swarm optical gas imaging, optical sensor calibration is verified as true under instrument bench testing. Its spatial localization margin is measured at 5.2 m, and it achieves a VOC mass detection rate of 180 kg/h.
SEN-OPT-MXW：For Downwind tracer-gas release dispersion profiling, optical sensor calibration is verified as true in bench calibration records. It achieves a spatial localization margin of 1.8 m, along with a VOC mass detection rate of 120 kg/h.
SEN-OPT-J1N：For Differential absorption lidar plume mapping, optical sensor calibration is verified as true per bench calibration dockets. Validation testing establishes a spatial localization margin of 2.6 m, and its certified VOC mass detection rate reaches 150 kg/h.
